comment: Photo-scanned masonry of the walls of the castles, one set for each style, and the tiles of their roofs (the style Roof, T_CastleRoof), CC0, from Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com/license). fetch_castle_textures.ps1 downloads them at the resolution below, which keeps them light, to Saved/TextureSources/castle/<id> as <id>_color.jpg and <id>_normal.jpg (DirectX); import_planet_castles.py textures imports them as T_CastleWall_<Style> and T_CastleWall_<Style>_N, and takes the masonry generate_castle_textures.py generates for a style whose set is not there.
